rule: Scenes are assigned whole. A test scene is never rendered for training or validation, and no procedural variant of a test scene (any seed) enters training. A later dated amendment may add scenes to train or validation; it may never move a scene out of test, and it may add to test only scenes no model has seen.

train.scene: the Source-style bake test room (raw_native_cli bake-room)
terrain (src/tools/hw_scenes.cpp), seeds 0 to 15 of the height field

materials: assigned per scene by the scene's owner; where a scene has none (the HW scenes), a seeded draw over M3's material families, with the seed recorded per frame
